name: email-marketing-bible
title_zh: 让 AI 代理成为懂行情的邮件营销操盘手
tagline_zh: 从投递率诊断到文案去油，19 个行业基准直接喂给代理。你负责下指令，它负责不踩 ESP 的坑。
tagline_en: From deliverability fixes to de-slopping copy, 19 industry benchmarks baked in. You command, it avoids ESP.
desc_en: Data-backed email marketing skill for AI agents. Use when building or running email automation, driving an ESP from an agent (MCP/connectors), diagnosing deliverability, writing or de-slopping email copy, designing emails, choosing a platform, or pulling benchmarks. Covers AI email automation, flows, deliverability, copywriting, segmentation, compliance, cold email, WhatsApp, SMS and RCS, and 19 i
why_zh: 不是零散技巧，而是把数据基准、合规边界和平台选型逻辑编码成代理可执行的决策树，减少试错成本。
why_en: Not scattered tips—it encodes benchmarks, compliance, and platform logic into an agent-executable decision tree, cutting.
limit_zh: 只覆盖邮件营销域，不含 CRM 或广告投放。基准基于北美市场，欧盟 GDPR 需自行补充。不生成可部署的 ESP 配置。
limit_en: Email marketing only—no CRM or ads. Benchmarks are US-centric; GDPR needs your own add-ons. Outputs strategy and copy, not deployable ESP configs.
